info.title: PBL6 internal service contracts
info.description: Private Compose network only; never route through gateway. Pending commands return 501 after caller authentication. Owner must implement DTO validation and business scopes.

get.description: Active Store IDs. First-party readers request cursor pages with size<=100; after is the last returned UUID. Without size/after, the legacy unpaged response remains available during reader-first rollout. Each page reads current ACTIVE status; it is not a transaction spanning membership or Store changes.

post.summary: Restock only inspected sellable received items
post.description: M2 provides one immutable receipt. M1 checks consumed quantities and all previous returns under an Order lock. Empty items records a wholly non-sellable receipt without increasing inventory.

post.summary: Consume same-price replacements after inspected return receipt
post.description: One immutable dispatch per return receipt. Validates original consumed variants, equal snapshot price, replacement product and current available stock. Different-price or partial exchanges are refused.

post.summary: Kiểm quyền hiện hành và phạm vi đơn khi gắn ngữ cảnh hội thoại

next_after.description: Last returned UUID when more ACTIVE IDs follow; null when the cursor page ends. Omitted by legacy unpaged readers.

product_id.description: Canonical Product of an eligible owned OrderItem, returned when product_id is omitted.
